event.title: FBI Investigates Possible Hack of National Crime Information Center Database
event.canonical_title: FBI Investigates Possible Hack of National Crime Information Center Database
event.summary: The FBI is investigating a suspected breach of its National Crime Information Center database, which is utilized by law enforcement agencies to share critical information. Reports indicate that hackers may have compromised the database, prompting the bureau to examine the entry point and assess what data may have been affected. This incident marks the second cyberattack on the FBI in recent months.

timeline.title: FBI Investigates Possible Hack of National Crime Information Center Database
timeline.summary: The FBI is reportedly investigating a potential hack of the National Crime Information Center (NCIC) database, which is utilized by various law enforcement agencies to share critical criminal justice information. The NCIC contains records on fugitives, missing persons, and stolen property, among other data.
key_facts: FBI is investigating a possible hack.
The incident involves the National Crime Information Center database.
The NCIC is used by federal, state, and local law enforcement.
